description: Difficulty + popularity for a specific keyword (or up to 25 in bulk). Use this when you already know which keywords you care about — costs 1 credit per keyword. Works without an API key for up to 5 keywords/day (free tier, per IP); an API key removes that cap. Use sonar_keyword_search instead when you want related keyword ideas alongside metrics. Answers within about 30 seconds: a keyword that can't be computed in that time comes back as `pending` (queued on Sonar's scrape fleet, not charged, results are being cached) — call again after `retry_after_seconds` for just those keywords.

country.description: One of Sonar's 72 keyword-research markets, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "us", "gb", "de", "jp", "br"). Keyword data isn't available for other storefronts. Default "us".

keyword.description: Single keyword to fetch metrics for. Use this OR `keywords`, not both.

keywords.description: Bulk list of keywords to fetch metrics for (max 25). Use this OR `keyword`, not both. 1 credit per keyword.

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

name: sonar_keyword_metrics
title: Keyword Metrics
